result.title: DUGO: Dual-Scale Gaussian Memory for Online Temporal Action Localization in Egocentric Procedural Videos
result.comment: This paper has been accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (IEEE BigData 2026)
result.summary: Online Temporal Action Localization (OnTAL) aims to detect and localize action instances from untrimmed streaming videos in real time. Unlike offline approaches, OnTAL models have no access to future frames and cannot go back and refine earlier predictions, which makes the task considerably harder given the strict real-time constraints and narrow temporal window available. Most existing OnTAL methods lean on either brief anchor-based context or a single-scale memory of past frames, which limits how well they can capture actions unfolding across multiple time scales or requiring long-range reasoning in Procedural Videos. To address these gaps, we present DUGO (Dual-Scale Encoding and Gaussian Memory Online), a new OnTAL framework that jointly models local motion dynamics and long-range temporal dependencies. At its core, DUGO uses a Dual-Scale Temporal Encoder, pairing depth-wise local representations with global self-attention so it can pick up both fine-grained temporal patterns and broader contextual cues. We also introduce a Gaussian Memory Bank, which represents action memory as stochastic, input-conditioned Gaussian prototypes, allowing for richer temporal memory through gated cross-attention applied at both the encoder and anchor-query stages. Extensive experiments on procedural egocentric datasets (EGTEA, EPIC-Kitchens-100) demonstrate that DUGO achieves state-of-the-art performance while also providing substantial improvements on non-egocentric benchmarks such as Muses. The project page is available at: https://aman554-eq.github.io/DUGO

AI.brief_summary: 提出在线时序动作定位框架 DUGO：用双尺度时序编码器结合深度可分离局部表示与全局自注意力，并以高斯原型记忆库存储动作记忆，在编码器和 anchor-query 阶段通过门控交叉注意力调用，在自中心程序视频数据集上取得领先结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其在无未来帧的流式条件下维护紧凑的随机原型记忆并门控取用，可能与 LVR 的潜在状态更新、长程证据保留及实时预算下的决策相关，可供核查；但任务为纯视频动作定位，与 VLM 推理联系较远，迁移需自行判断。
